Jules Park: Quick sync 00 - we need to finalize office hours + workshop agenda for the Enable Sprint. 8 customers signed up; 2 asked for DB migration examples.
Riley Torres: Suggested format: 45m workshop (tech deep-dive) + 30m drop-in later in the week. timezone coverage: EMEA morning + APAC friendly early slot.
Samir Khan: I can cover DB migration patterns and rollback strategies. Available Tue 08:00-11:00 UTC or Thu 14:00-17:00 UTC.
Elena Ortiz: I'll lead onboarding checklist + success criteria. prefer Tue afternoon UTC.
Jules Park: Candidate slots: 
- 1) Tue 09:00 UTC (45m deep-dive)
- 2) Wed 15:00 UTC (45m deep-dive alt)
- 3) Thu 07:00 UTC (30m drop-in)
- 4) Fri 16:00 UTC (30m drop-in)
Jules Park: React with :one:/:two:/:three:/:four:. Also add any must-have agenda items.
Riley Torres: :one: for deep-dive, :three: for drop-in. APAC customers prefer earlier drop-ins.
Samir Khan: :one: works. add a segment on schema versioning and simple rollback snippet.
Elena Ortiz: :two: would also work for me if Wed gives better EMEA attendance. but tentatively :one:. I'll prepare the success criteria template.
Jules Park: Draft agenda for 45m deep-dive:
```
00-05m - intros + objectives
05-25m - migration patterns & rollback (Samir)
25-35m - onboarding checklist & monitoring (Elena)
35-42m - Q&A
42-45m - next steps + follow-ups
```
Jules Park: Pre-read ask: sample token rates, current infra notes, request a list of critical prompts. share 72h prior.
Samir Khan: I'll create a small rollback script snippet for pre-read.
Elena Ortiz: I'll build the one-page success criteria + Gainsight tags.
CS Scheduler Bot: Calendar event created: Enable Sprint 024 Deep-dive 025 Tue 09:00 UTC. Invitees: customers + internal leads. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1758123456
Jules Park: Please also create two drop-in events (Thu 07:00 UTC, Fri 16:00 UTC) with capacity 8.
CS Scheduler Bot: Drop-ins created. RSVP link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/sprint/dropins/1758123456
Riley Torres: I'll message the two customers who requested DB examples and confirm they can join Tue 09:00.
Jules Park: Who owns post-session feedback? usual 3-question form.
Elena Ortiz: I'll own feedback and tag follow-ups high-priority in Gainsight.
Samir Khan: I'll add the rollback snippet to the pre-read doc by EOD tomorrow.
Jules Park: Great. Quick dry-run 15m Monday 14:00 UTC. Invite coming. Any objections?
Riley Torres: none. good to go.
Jules Park: Closing thread and moving items to CS Ops board. Thanks!
